name: NONETTO
source:
A world where gods and spirits exist and where not only people but also various other creatures live. In addition to science and medicine, magic has established itself as an academic discipline, and many people specialize in it.

The North Vigend Academy of Magic is a comprehensive academy that offers magic, theology, science, and a variety of other specialties, and has a wide range of courses, from secondary school to university. Players take on the role of Laphin-Crober, the protagonist of the story, and live in the academy. There, “Laphin” will meet various people and weave a story. Who will you meet and write your feelings?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010307125337/http://lin2.magical.gr.jp/~akira/alchimie/nohtml/nonetto.html]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
神灵存在的世界，不仅有人类，还有各种其他生物居住的世界。除了科学和医学之外，魔法也已成为一门学科，并且许多人专门研究它。

北维根魔法学院是一所综合性学院，提供魔法、神学、科学等多种专业，课程范围广泛，从中学到大学。玩家扮演故事主角Laphin-Crober，住在学院里。在那里，“拉芬”会遇到各种各样的人，编织一个故事。你会遇见谁并写下你的感受？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010307125337/http://lin2.magical.gr.jp/~akira/alchimie/nohtml/nonetto.html]官方网站[/url]]
